== Numbered white-on-black source ==
The numbered white-on-black print option appears on the Players Committee's ''Virtual Set #1a'' sheet, distributed through Decipher. The corresponding numbered black-on-white article already exists; it is not recreated or replaced. Both numbered sheets have the same words and numerical values for this card. The earlier unnumbered #1a presentation, Premium Edition and later PC remastered slip remain distinct.

Source: [[Media:Decipher-Virtual-Set-1a-numbered.pdf|numbered Set #1a PDF]], page 1, collector label 1•7; counterpart [[Media:Decipher-Virtual-Set-1-numbered.pdf|numbered Set #1 PDF]]. PDF creation metadata records 6 March 2002 and the sheet states tournament legality from 9 March 2002. These facts do not establish the exact publication day. The article image is a direct source-sheet rasterization, not a new full-card reconstruction.

Uncovered lore, destiny, type and upper-card attributes were checked against the printed Premiere [[Darth Vader]]. Covered numerical values and game text follow the numbered sheet. No new GEMP identifier or gameplay-state mapping is claimed. The publication identity is <code>ovs1-numbered-white-on-black-7</code>.

Verification is recorded under Story 454. Work is limited to the six Dark Side cards on the supplied numbered Set #1 and #1a sheets; no other-set audit is included. Exact source/draft/live backups and central registration are tracked separately from external preservation. Archive.org uploads remain paused; no capture submission was made.

Character landspeed 1 is supplied by [[Media:Decipher Rulebook 2.0.pdf|Decipher Rulebook 2.0]], PDF page 10, “Landspeed”, rather than printed on the numbered slip. Other applicable statistics follow the checked source face/slip as documented above.

== Set 1 edition names ==
Bill approved consistent Luke/Vader Set 1 names: Original (unnumbered), Numbered (black-on-white) / Numbered (white-on-black) for the distinct Dark Side options, one Numbered entry for Luke’s identical Light Side panels, Premium, and Remastered (2006). Article moves retain redirects; the shared navigators and direct links use the descriptive edition names. Publication history replaces the generic Errata heading on these Set 1 articles; historical catalog codes are retained in source. Card identities, printed text, statistics, images and source attribution are unchanged. Legacy Block classifications are outside this batch.
